Hi Jonas,

Our renewal for the Redwood Dedicated reservation is up on 2026-08-15. Since we started the pilot this quarter we've hit the 75% utilization threshold on the reserved GPUs and predict peak months will exceed our current pool. We want to add 8 additional A100-equivalent GPUs to the reserved pool and keep the renewal date unchanged (co-term).

Key asks: 
- Can we bundle the expansion into the existing renewal so a single PO/renewal date covers everything?
- We prefer quarterly invoicing rather than annual upfront for this expansion line item — can Redwood support a split billing schedule (renewal for base capacity annual + quarterly billing for incremental capacity)?
- Need any updated SLA/throughput guarantees documented for the expanded pool (we have a throughput SLO requirement for 95th p95 latency).

I can loop in procurement but wanted to confirm product/ops feasibility before they issue paperwork.

Thanks,
